rows.what: The community repository merges a complete Lean proof on Mathlib's multi-stack machine, at κ = 296/(10^11·2^131), with its own check of the three axioms.
Asks the upstream community for "Independent review of the linked theorem statement and machine/time model". Still open when read.

A note on the community statement: Mathlib's machine makes only the input alphabet finite, and a kernel-checked lemma on definitions extracted from Mathlib shows that the alphabet a machine can reach is finite anyway.
A third Lean development, in a k-tape model of its own, at OpenAI's κ = 2^-182; later at 3666565558019/10^17 (2026-10-21). Not audited here.
The community theorem reaches κ = 4222422970/2^46, the saving it has at the commit audited here.
